review.method: Manual business specification cross-checked against separately implemented Decimal calculator and authored SQL, with counterfactuals; external business certification remains outside this synthetic benchmark.
limitations: F1-07-V0 gains an explicit preceding revenue turn; standalone metric omission is not accepted as unambiguous.
Conversation input contains user turns only; no production anchors or historical assistant responses are proven.
checks: Revenue is billed value in reais, not collection or energy.
All physical revenue grain rows are summed, including distinct tariff flags.
2026 annual request cannot be silently reduced to available January-June.
Comparison requires two complete January-June windows; difference is 2026 minus 2025.
Ranking uses interval sums and municipality ascending for tied totals; four available groups do not imply five fabricated groups.
Zero, absence and all-null are separate evidence states; no causal explanation is derived from sums.
